ReproRepo can serve as a reusable, scalable framework for future evaluations of LLM agents on real-world reproducibility auditing. Our code is released at https://github.com/LithiumDA/ReproRepo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ReproRepo，一个基于GitHub Issues的可扩展框架，用于评估LLM代理在真实可复现性问题上的表现，实验表明Codex with GPT-5.5能识别约90%论文的语义相关问题。
AI.motivation: 现有可复现性基准依赖大量人工标注，难以扩展，需要一种更高效、自动化的评估方法。
AI.method: 利用GitHub Issues作为自然监督信号，构建包含1149篇ML论文的框架，评估四种LLM代理配置。
AI.result: 最佳代理（Codex with GPT-5.5）可为约90%论文识别至少一个语义相关的可复现性问题；代理擅长发现显性失败和定位正确语义区域，但精确定位不足。
AI.conclusion: ReproRepo可作为可重用的可扩展框架，用于未来LLM代理在真实世界可复现性审计中的评估。

title: First Proof Second Batch
summary:
To assess the ability of current AI systems to correctly solve research-level mathematics problems, we tested several AI systems on a set of ten problems in a broad range of mathematical fields; these problems arose naturally in the research process of the contributors. This document includes the problems, our methodology, and the results of our testing. We provide links to supplementary documents including the human solutions, the AI-generated solutions, and the referee reports and logs for the AI-generated solutions.
  The ten problems were contributed by the following mathematicians: (1) Dariusz Kalociński and Theodore A. Slaman, (2) Richard Schwartz, (3) Aleksa Milojevic and Benny Sudakov, (4) Larry Guth, (5) Oleg Butkovsky, Jonathan Mattingly, and Lorenzo Zambotti, (6) Joshua Evan Greene and Duncan McCoy, (7) Sucharit Sarkar, (8) Sam Payne and Jidong (Jayden) Wang, (9) Sylvie Corteel and John Lentfer, (10) Srivatsav Kunnawalkam Elayavalli.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了多个AI系统在10个研究级数学问题上的解题能力，这些问题由不同数学家提供，涵盖了广泛数学领域，并附有完整的人类解答、AI解答及评审记录。
AI.motivation: 评估当前AI系统能否正确解决研究级数学问题，检验其在真实科研场景中的数学推理能力。
AI.method: 选取10个来自不同数学家研究过程中的数学问题，涵盖多个数学领域，对多个AI系统进行测试，并生成人类解答和AI解答，同时记录评审报告和日志。
AI.result: 提供了问题集、测试方法、测试结果，以及补充材料链接（包括人类解答、AI解答、评审报告和日志）。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统化的测试与评审流程，展示了当前AI在研究级数学问题上的表现，为后续AI数学推理能力评估提供了参考。

title: Variable-Width Transformers
summary: Scaling model size, specifically depth and width, has driven significant progress in transformer-based language models. However, most architectures maintain a constant width across all layers, allocating a fixed parameter and computation budget evenly despite different layers potentially playing distinct computational roles. In this work, we empirically investigate nonuniform capacity allocation across network depth by proposing a $\times$-shaped > <former architecture. This design maintains wider early and late layers while narrowing the middle layers, utilizing a parameter-free residual resizing mechanism. Across decoder-only language models ranging from 200M to 2B parameters (dense) and 3B parameters (MoE), our > <former consistently outperforms parameter-matched uniform baselines on language modeling loss. By reducing the average layer width, this architecture also requires fewer overall FLOPs (22% reduction under fitted loss-matched scaling curves) and smaller KV cache memory and I/O cost (15% reduction). In analysis, we show that this bottleneck structure results in qualitatively different representations in residual streams. Overall, our results demonstrate that nonuniform width allocation can result in more resource-optimal scaling of language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种非均匀宽度分配的×形Transformer架构（宽-窄-宽），在200M到3B参数的语言模型中，相比均匀宽度基线模型，以更少的FLOPs（降低22%）和KV缓存（降低15%）取得了更优的语言建模损失。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer语言模型通常在各层保持均匀宽度，忽视了不同层可能承担不同计算角色，导致参数和计算资源分配效率低下。
AI.method: 提出×形former架构：保持早期和晚期层宽度较大，中间层宽度较窄，并采用无参数的残差缩放机制实现不同宽度层之间的连接。
AI.result: 在200M到2B（密集）和3B（MoE）参数规模上，该架构一致优于参数匹配的均匀基线；在拟合的损失-规模曲线上减少22%FLOPs，KV缓存内存和I/O成本降低15%。
AI.conclusion: 非均匀的宽度分配能够实现更资源最优的语言模型扩展，表明中间层可以用更窄的宽度有效工作。

title: Structured Adversarial Camouflage via Voronoi Diagrams
summary:
Pixel-wise adversarial patches are computationally heavy and often visually detectable, limiting utility in security-critical systems. We present adversarial Voronoi camouflage that optimizes only seed-point locations under fixed, printable palettes using a soft assignment, producing structured, splinter camouflage-like patterns without additional regularization. Evaluated on person detection with COCO-style AP@[.5:.95], naive placement (Inria -> COCO) performs comparably bad, while garment-level application via segmentation mask (3DPeople) results in a significant AP drop. The attack transfers to out-of-domain backgrounds and across detector families (YOLOv9/10/11/12), indicating robustness in black-box settings. Repainting with different palettes largely nullifies the effect, and single-color tweaks show limited tolerance (<=0.17), highlighting a structure-palette coupling. The parameter-efficient, palette-constrained design improves visual plausibility while degrading real-time detector performance. Physical validation and color calibration are left for future work.
  Code: https://github.com/JensBayer/Voronoi
  This paper was originally presented at the International Conference on Military Communication and Information Systems (ICMCIS), organized by the Information Systems Technology (IST) Scientific and Technical Committee, IST-224-RSY - the ICMCIS, held in Bath, United Kingdom, 12-13 May 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Voronoi图的对抗性伪装方法，通过仅优化种子点位置并固定可打印调色板，生成结构化伪装图案，有效降低行人检测器的性能（AP显著下降），并在多种检测器间具有良好的黑盒迁移性。
AI.motivation: 传统像素级对抗补丁计算量大且视觉上可检测，限制了其在安全关键系统中的应用。作者希望设计一种参数高效、视觉更自然且能有效攻击检测器的对抗性伪装方法。
AI.method: 使用Voronoi图结构，仅优化种子点位置，采用软分配策略在固定可打印调色板下生成图案；通过分割掩膜（3DPeople数据集）实现衣物级别的对抗补丁应用，而非简单的图像级贴放。
AI.result: 在行人检测任务上，衣物级应用导致AP显著下降；攻击可迁移至域外背景及多种YOLO检测器系列（YOLOv9/10/11/12）；更换调色板可基本消除攻击效果，单色微调容忍度低（≤0.17）。
AI.conclusion: 参数高效、调色板约束的设计提高了视觉合理性，同时降低了实时检测器性能；证实了结构-调色板的耦合效应；物理验证和颜色校准留待未来工作。

title: Knowledge Reutilization in Meta-Reinforcement Learning
summary: Meta-reinforcement learning enables fast adaptation by extracting shared structure from related tasks, but existing end-to-end methods often couple task inference with embodiment-specific control. This coupling can obscure non-parametric task semantics, reduce sample efficiency, and limit cross-agent reuse. We propose a meta-knowledge reutilization framework that learns task-level knowledge on a dynamics-simplified agent and transfers it to heterogeneous agents. The framework uses a Bayesian non-parametric prior to organize latent task modes and a high-level policy to generate task-level magnitude guidance. To bridge reusable task knowledge with different embodiments, we introduce a semantic-magnitude interface and a lightweight temporal adaptor, which convert frozen meta-knowledge into temporally aligned subgoals for embodiment-specific low-level controllers. Experiments on multiple locomotion agents show that our framework reduces final-step tracking error by 94.75% -- 99.79% compared with recent state-of-the-art baselines and achieves comparable deployment performance with about 23.8% of their interaction data.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种元知识复用框架，通过简化动力学智能体学习任务知识并迁移到异构智能体，引入贝叶斯非参数先验和语义-幅度接口，实现跨具身任务适配，显著降低跟踪误差并提升数据效率。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端元强化学习方法将任务推理与具身控制耦合，导致非参数任务语义模糊、样本效率低、跨智能体重用受限。
AI.method: 在动力学简化智能体上学习任务级元知识，使用贝叶斯非参数先验组织隐式任务模式，通过语义-幅度接口和时序适配器将冻结元知识转化为具身特定子目标。
AI.result: 在多种运动智能体上，最终步跟踪误差降低94.75%-99.79%，仅用约23.8%交互数据达到可比部署性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解耦任务推理与具身控制，实现元知识跨异构智能体高效迁移，显著提升样本效率和任务适配能力。

title: Heterogeneous SAR-optical fusion for near-real-time land use and land cover mapping under cloud contamination: A novel framework and global benchmark dataset
summary: Optical remote sensing imagery is frequently degraded by cloud and cloud-shadow contamination, which limits its reliability for near-real-time land use and land cover (LULC) mapping. Although synthetic aperture radar (SAR) can provide cloud-penetrating structural information, existing SAR-optical fusion methods often assume reliable optical observations and insufficiently address the semantic uncertainty introduced by cloud contamination. To address this issue, we propose CloudLULC-Net, an end-to-end heterogeneous SAR-optical fusion framework that directly predicts LULC maps from cloud-contaminated Sentinel-2 imagery and temporally adjacent Sentinel-1 SAR observations. The proposed network incorporates optical reliability modulation to suppress unreliable optical responses, heterogeneous information adaptive aggregation to model high-order spatial-channel interactions between optical and SAR representations, and a unified semantic mapping transformer to organize fused features in a LULC-oriented latent space. A semantic anchor-guided optimization strategy is further introduced to improve the consistency of intermediate semantic representations. To support this task, we construct CloudLULC-Set, a large-scale benchmark dataset containing 40,223 curated SAR-optical-label triplets with pixel-level LULC annotations across diverse geographic regions and cloud conditions. Experimental results show that CloudLULC-Net achieves an OA of 86.60%, an F1-score of 83.29%, and an mIoU of 73.51%, outperforming representative heterogeneous reconstruction-first and end-to-end SAR-optical mapping methods. Comparisons with existing global LULC products and analyses under different cloud-cover levels further demonstrate the robustness and practical value of CloudLULC-Net for target-date LULC mapping in cloud-prone regions.The project is publicly available at: https://github.com/RSIIPAC/CloudLULC

AI.tldr: 本文提出CloudLULC-Net，一种端到端的SAR-光学异源融合框架，用于从云污染的光学遥感影像和雷达数据中直接预测土地利用/土地覆盖图，并构建了包含4万多样本的基准数据集，在云覆盖区域实现了优于现有方法的鲁棒性能。
AI.motivation: 光学遥感影像常受云和云阴影污染，限制了其在近实时土地利用/土地覆盖制图中的可靠性。现有SAR-光学融合方法通常假设光学观测可靠，未能充分解决云污染引入的语义不确定性。
AI.method: 提出CloudLULC-Net，包含光学可靠性调制模块、异源信息自适应聚合模块和统一语义映射Transformer；引入语义锚点引导优化策略；构建包含40,223个三元组的CloudLULC-Set基准数据集。
AI.result: OA达86.60%，F1-score为83.29%，mIoU为73.51%，优于代表性异源重建优先和端到端SAR-光学映射方法。
AI.conclusion: CloudLULC-Net在云覆盖区域的目标日期土地利用/土地覆盖制图中展现出鲁棒性和实用价值，代码已开源。

title: Your AI Travel Agent Would Book You a Bullfight: An Agentic Benchmark for Implicit Animal Welfare in Frontier AI Models
summary: AI agents are moving from advisors to actors, booking travel, planning menus, and running procurement on behalf of users. Existing benchmarks for AI and animal welfare evaluate model text responses to question-answer prompts, leaving open whether the welfare reasoning surfaced in those responses transfers to agentic deployment where the model must take actions with tools. We introduce TAC (Travel Agent Compassion), the first agentic benchmark measuring whether AI agents avoid options involving animal exploitation when acting on behalf of users. TAC presents an AI agent with twelve hand-authored travel booking scenarios across six categories of animal exploitation, augmented to forty-eight samples to control for price, rating, and position confounds. We evaluate seven frontier models from four labs. Every model scores below the chance level of sixty-four percent, with the best performer (Claude Opus 4.7) at fifty-three percent. A single welfare-aware sentence in the system prompt yields gains of forty-seven to sixty-three percentage points in Claude and GPT-5.5, twenty-six points in GPT-5.2, and under twelve points in DeepSeek and Gemini. An auxiliary Inspect Scout audit of 288 base-condition transcripts from the top two performers, using Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite as judge, flags zero transcripts for evaluation awareness, suggesting the below-chance rates do not stem from the models recognising the evaluation. We discuss implications for category-level variation across cultural domains, the limits of text-response welfare benchmarks, and the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice systemic risk framework.

AI.tldr: TAC基准测试首次评估AI智能体在代理部署中是否避免动物剥削选项，发现七种前沿模型均低于随机水平（64%），最佳模型（Claude Opus 4.7）仅53%，但系统提示中加入单句福利意识可使表现提升高达63个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有AI与动物福利基准仅评估模型对问答提示的文本响应，未测试在需要工具操作的代理部署场景中，福利推理能力是否能够迁移。
AI.method: 构建TAC（Travel Agent Compassion）基准，包含12个手工编写的旅行预订场景（涵盖6类动物剥削），扩充至48个样本以控制价格、评分和位置混淆因素，评估7个前沿模型，并辅以Inspector Scout审计检测评估意识。
AI.result: 所有模型得分均低于机会水平64%，最佳模型Claude Opus 4.7为53%；系统提示中单句福利意识提示使Claude和GPT-5.5提升47-63个百分点，GPT-5.2提升26个百分点，DeepSeek和Gemini提升不足12个百分点；审计未发现模型识别出评估的迹象。
AI.conclusion: 讨论了类别层面跨文化领域的差异、文本响应福利基准的局限性，以及对EU通用AI实践准则系统性风险框架的影响。

title: GSPan: A Continuous Gaussian Primitive Representation for Arbitrary-Scale Pansharpening
summary: Pansharpening aims to generate high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) images by fusing low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) and panchromatic (PAN) observations. Most existing deep learning methods treat pansharpening as fixed-grid prediction, which limits scale adaptation. To address this, we propose GSPan, a framework that introduces 2D Gaussian Splatting (GS) into pansharpening. Instead of directly predicting pixels, GSPan represents band-wise residual details as continuous and learnable 2D Gaussian primitives. We design a Dual-Stream Hierarchical Interaction (DSHI) architecture with a Spatial-Spectral Interactive Attention (SSIA) module to estimate these primitives from complementary PAN and MS observations. The predicted primitives are rendered as a residual detail field and injected into the upsampled MS image. This continuous representation allows GSPan to render fused images on arbitrary target sampling grids without scale-specific retraining. It further enables a Scale-Decoupled Asymmetric Inference (SDAI) strategy, which estimates primitives at a reduced resolution and renders the fused image at the target resolution for efficient large-scene pansharpening. Experiments on QuickBird, GaoFen-2, WorldView-3, and WorldView-3-4K datasets show that GSPan delivers state-of-the-art fusion performance. Moreover, SDAI markedly accelerates inference, achieving a favorable trade-off between computational efficiency and fusion quality. Our results demonstrate the potential of continuous Gaussian residual representations as a flexible and scale-decoupled alternative to fixed-grid prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出GSPan框架，将2D高斯泼溅引入全色锐化，通过连续高斯基元表示残差细节，实现任意尺度融合与高效推理，在多个数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法将全色锐化视为固定网格预测，限制了尺度自适应能力，无法灵活处理不同分辨率的融合任务。
AI.method: 提出GSPan框架，用2D高斯基元表示波段级残差细节；设计双流层次交互(DSHI)架构和空间-光谱交互注意力(SSIA)模块估计基元；通过可微渲染生成残差细节场注入上采样MS图像；提出尺度解耦非对称推理(SDAI)策略实现高效大场景锐化。
AI.result: 在QuickBird、GaoFen-2、WorldView-3、WorldView-3-4K数据集上达到SOTA融合性能，SDAI策略显著加速推理，实现了计算效率与融合质量的良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 连续高斯残差表示可作为固定网格预测的灵活、尺度解耦的替代方案，展示了在全色锐化中的巨大潜力。

title: ActWorld: From Explorable to Interactive World Model via Action-Aware Memory
summary: Interactive world models aim to simulate environment dynamics under real-time user actions. However, their action vocabulary is largely confined to navigation: most actions correspond to motion (e.g., walk, turn, look around), while interaction with objects in the scene (e.g., pick up plates, open doors, or trigger physical responses) is either absent, restricted to game domains, or relegated to prompt-to-full-video scenarios. The resulting worlds are visually explorable but not truly actionable. In this work, we present ActWorld, an interactive world model that extends prior navigation-centric generators to support mid-rollout object interaction within a chunk-autoregressive framework. We argue that the navigation-interaction gap stems from two bottlenecks. First, a data bottleneck: the lack of human-object interaction data with accurate, dense labels. Second, a memory bottleneck: recency-biased history compression in existing world models discards the event-transition frames that causally determine subsequent object states, leading to an action-forgetting pathology. On the data side, we construct a 100K interaction video dataset, each annotated with per-chunk captions via chain-of-thought reasoning. On the model side, we introduce a hierarchical action-aware memory design that routes history compression by interaction importance, complemented by a persistent memory bank that maintains event-update and object-identity tokens across long rollouts. Experiments show that ActWorld supports both flexible navigation and rich object interaction within a single model, substantially improving interaction fidelity over navigation-only baselines without sacrificing viewpoint control. Project page is available at https://interactwm.github.io/ActWorld.

AI.tldr: ActWorld提出了一种交互式世界模型，在现有以导航为主的生成框架基础上，通过构建10万段交互视频数据集和层级化动作感知记忆机制，实现了在滚动生成过程中支持物体交互（如拾取盘子、开门等）与导航的融合。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式世界模型的动作词汇局限于导航（行走、转向等），缺乏对场景中物体的交互能力（如拾取物体、开门、触发物理响应），导致生成的世界虽然可视觉探索但不可真正操作。作者认为这一"导航-交互鸿沟"源于两大瓶颈：数据瓶颈（缺乏带精确密集标注的人-物交互数据）和记忆瓶颈（现有世界模型基于近因偏好的历史压缩会丢弃因果决定后续物体状态的事件转换帧，导致动作遗忘病理）。
AI.method: 1) 数据层面：构建10万段交互视频数据集，通过思维链推理为每段标注分块字幕。2) 模型层面：引入层级化动作感知记忆设计，按交互重要性路由历史压缩，并辅以持久记忆库，在长序列生成中维护事件更新和物体身份token。整体在块自回归框架内扩展了既有导航生成器以支持中间滚动过程中的物体交互。
AI.result: 实验表明，ActWorld能够在单一模型中同时支持灵活的导航和丰富的物体交互，相比纯导航基线大幅提升交互保真度，且不牺牲视角控制能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过解决数据瓶颈和记忆瓶颈，ActWorld成功弥合了导航与交互之间的鸿沟，使交互式世界模型从"可探索"迈向"可操作"，为构建更真实、更可交互的虚拟世界奠定了基础。

title: BrainWorld: A Structural-Prior-Conditioned Generative Model for Whole-Brain 4D fMRI Dynamics
summary: Whole-brain 4D fMRI generation is valuable for modeling functional brain dynamics, yet existing fMRI foundation models mainly target representation learning and downstream prediction rather than conditional predictive generation. We introduce BrainWorld, a structural-prior-conditioned generative model for whole-brain 4D fMRI dynamics. BrainWorld uses sMRI as subject-level anatomical context to guide future fMRI generation, integrating structural information into the denoising process rather than treating it as a parallel modality. Evaluated on 22 datasets spanning diverse cohorts and brain states, BrainWorld generates stable 4D fMRI trajectories up to 400 frames, improves downstream performance through generated-example augmentation, and learns transferable multimodal representations that outperform baselines. Together, these results establish BrainWorld as a condition-aware generative framework for long-horizon brain dynamics modeling and multimodal representation learning.

AI.tldr: BrainWorld是一个基于结构先验的条件生成模型，用于全脑4D fMRI动态生成，在22个数据集上稳定生成长达400帧的fMRI轨迹，并能通过生成样本增强提升下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有fMRI基础模型主要聚焦于表征学习和下游预测任务，缺乏条件性预测生成能力，无法有效建模全脑4D功能动态。
AI.method: 利用sMRI作为被试级别的解剖先验，将其整合到去噪过程中指导未来fMRI帧的生成，而非作为并行模态处理。
AI.result: 在22个数据集上稳定生成长达400帧的4D fMRI轨迹；通过生成样本增强提升了下游任务性能；学习到的跨模态表征优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: BrainWorld建立了一个条件感知的生成框架，可用于长时程脑动力学建模和多模态表征学习。

title: Learning Cardiac Electrophysiology Digital Twins Through Agentic Discovery of Hybrid Structure
summary: Building personalized cardiac electrophysiology (EP) digital twins requires identifying the appropriate model structure for each patient, not merely fitting parameters. Traditional methods rely on experts to manually prescribe hybrid physics-neural architectures, which requires deep domain expertise and does not transfer across patients. Recent works have applied large language models (LLMs) to generate or act as hybrid models. However, despite their promising generalization capacity, these LLM-based methods lack the structural priors needed for stable cardiac simulations. Hence, we propose LEADS, a framework that formulates cardiac EP domain knowledge as a structured action space and utilizes an LLM agent to discover hybrid models. The agent follows an iterative reasoning-and-action loop to select, combine, and refine hybrid models, whilst gradient descent handles parameter fitting. The proposed LEADS designs every candidate model towards physically grounded, interpretable, and numerically stable, while allowing open-ended architectural discovery. We validate LEADS on synthetic data with three ground-truth reaction models and on real cardiac EP data, demonstrating that it outperforms both human-designed hybrid models and other LLM-based hybrid modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出LEADS框架，利用LLM智能体在结构化动作空间中搜索混合模型，实现个性化心脏电生理数字孪生的自动构建，优于人工设计和纯LLM方法。
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖专家手动设计混合物理-神经架构，跨患者迁移性差；现有LLM方法缺乏结构先验导致数值不稳定。需要一种既能自动发现模型结构又能保证物理稳定性的方法。
AI.method: 将心脏EP领域知识形式化为结构化动作空间，LLM智能体通过迭代推理-行动循环选择、组合和优化混合模型，参数拟合由梯度下降完成。每个候选模型保证物理可解释性、数值稳定性，同时支持开放式架构发现。
AI.result: 在合成数据（三种真实反应模型）和真实心脏EP数据上验证，LEADS优于人类设计的混合模型和其他基于LLM的混合建模方法。
AI.conclusion: LEADS通过结构化动作空间约束LLM智能体，成功兼顾了模型发现的开放性和物理稳定性，为个性化心脏数字孪生提供自动化解决方案。

title: LiveStarPro: Proactive Streaming Video Understanding with Hierarchical Memory for Long-Horizon Streams
summary: Despite the remarkable progress of Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs), current online architectures still struggle to simultaneously process continuous video streams, decide autonomously when to respond, and preserve long-horizon contextual memory. These obstacles undermine real-time responsiveness and cause severe forgetting throughout prolonged interactions. In this work, we introduce LiveStarPro, a live streaming assistant that is designed for proactive video understanding over long-horizon streams. The design of LiveStarPro rests on three complementary components. The first component is Streaming Verification Decoding (SVeD), an inference framework that identifies the appropriate response timing through single-pass perplexity verification, thereby eliminating the dependency on explicit silence tokens. The second component is Streaming Causal Attention Masks (SCAM), a training strategy that enforces incremental video-language alignment over variable-length streams. The third component is Tree-Structured Hierarchical Memory (TSHM), a recursive memory architecture that organizes evicted historical information into event chains and consequently enables efficient retrieval from effectively unbounded video streams. To facilitate a comprehensive evaluation under realistic online conditions, we further present OmniStarPro, a large-scale benchmark that spans 15 diverse real-world scenarios and that extends to hour-scale streams for the assessment of long-term recall. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiveStarPro consistently surpasses existing methods, attaining a 28.9% improvement in semantic correctness and an 18.2% reduction in timing error, while its streaming key-value cache further yields a 1.58x inference speedup over the same model without caching. The model and the code are publicly available at https://github.com/sotayang/LiveStarPro.

AI.tldr: LiveStarPro 是一个面向长时间视频流的实时助手，通过 SVeD（响应时机决策）、SCAM（流式注意力掩码训练）和 TSHM（树状层级记忆）三个组件，解决了在线视频理解中的实时响应和长时遗忘问题。在 OmniStarPro 基准测试中，相比现有方法，语义正确性提升 28.9%，时序误差降低 18.2%，推理速度提升 1.58 倍。
AI.motivation: 当前视频大语言模型在处理连续视频流时面临三大挑战：无法实时响应、难以自主决定何时回应用户、以及长时间交互中上下文记忆严重丢失。这些问题阻碍了实时视频助手在实际场景中的应用。
AI.method: 提出三个核心组件：1) SVeD（流式验证解码）：通过单次遍历的困惑度验证确定响应时机，无需显式静默令牌；2) SCAM（流式因果注意力掩码）：一种训练策略，强制模型在可变长度流上实现增量式视频-语言对齐；3) TSHM（树状层级记忆）：递归记忆架构，将被驱逐的历史信息组织成事件链，实现超长视频流中的高效检索。
AI.result: 在 OmniStarPro 基准（涵盖15个真实场景、小时级视频流）上，LiveStarPro 语义正确性提升 28.9%，时序误差降低 18.2%；流式键值缓存带来 1.58 倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: LiveStarPro 在长视频流的实时理解和响应方面显著超越现有方法，开源代码和模型可供社区进一步研究。

title: DRFLOW: A Deep Research Benchmark for Personalized Workflow Prediction
summary: Deep research (DR) systems are increasingly used for complex information-seeking tasks, but existing works mainly focus on generating reports and summaries. In contrast, many enterprise tasks instead require an agent to identify concrete workflows which is a sequence of action-steps. For example, rather than summarizing budgeting policies, an agent should be able to determine the steps needed to answer a question such as: "How do I request new headcount given a fixed budget?". Therefore, we introduce DRFLOW, a benchmark for evaluating personalized workflows predicted by agents from heterogeneous sources. Each task requires the agent to identify relevant evidence from scattered sources, then use that evidence to predict the correct action-step sequence for the user's task. DRFLOW contains 100 tasks across five domains, with 1,246 reference workflow steps grounded in more than 3,900 sources. We define seven diagnostic metrics covering factual grounding, step recovery, structural ordering, condition resolution, and personalization. We further present DRFLOW-Agent (DRFA), a workflow-oriented reference agent to predict personalized workflow. We show that although DRFA improves over strong baseline agents (upto 10.02% average F1 score), there is substantial room for improvement remains across these workflow metrics, indicating that predicting complete and correct personalized workflows remains a challenging frontier for deep research.

AI.tldr: 提出了DRFLOW基准和DRFA代理，用于评估和预测个性化工作流（行动步骤序列），实验表明现有方法仍有较大改进空间。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究系统主要关注生成报告和摘要，但在企业任务中，代理需要识别具体的工作流（行动步骤序列），而非仅仅总结信息。
AI.method: 构建了DRFLOW基准（100个任务、5个领域、1246个参考步骤、3900+来源），定义了7个诊断指标；并提出了DRFLOW-Agent参考代理来预测个性化工作流。
AI.result: DRFA相比强基线代理平均F1提升10.02%，但在工作流指标上仍有较大改进空间。
AI.conclusion: 预测完整且正确的个性化工作流仍是深度研究领域的一个挑战性前沿问题。

title: MaineCoon: Pursuing A Real-Time Audio-Visual Social World Model
summary: As an increasing majority of global video content is consumed on social platforms for interactive social purposes, video generation models built for social worlds are important but largely overlooked by previous studies. In this work, we define the position of social world models and build a prototype model as the first step towards this goal. While previous world models successfully simulate physical environments or gaming world exploration, they remain fundamentally detached from human-centric social dynamics. To bridge this gap as the first step to social world models, we present MaineCoon, the first real-time audio-visual autoregressive model that has 22B parameters and is capable of real-time streaming generation and sub-second interaction, with a record-breaking frame rate of up to 47.5 FPS, on a single GPU. To the best of our knowledge, MaineCoon is also the first real-time audio-visual generation model specifically optimized for social-interactive applications. To enable efficient and stable training, we introduce several novel techniques into MaineCoon, including self-resampling, cross-modal representation alignment, domain-aware preference optimization, and reinforced online-policy distillation (ROPD). We also design the first agentic streaming inference framework that supports thousand-second-scale or even longer generation while mitigating drift with agentic cache management and prompt planing. These innovations significantly accelerate training while optimizing real-time inference performance. We believe this work not only sets a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance benchmark for high-quality, low-latency, and long-horizon audio-visual autoregressive models, but also points out the paradigm shift desired for next-generation AI-native social platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MaineCoon，一个首个面向社交交互场景的22B参数实时音视频自回归生成模型，支持单GPU上高达47.5 FPS的流式生成和亚秒级交互，并引入了自重采样、跨模态对齐、领域偏好优化和强化在线策略蒸馏等创新技术，为下一代AI原生社交平台树立了新标杆。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型主要关注物理环境模拟或游戏世界探索，缺乏对以人为中心的社交动态的建模能力，而社交平台上视频内容消费日益增长，面向社交世界的视频生成模型却被严重忽视。
AI.method: 提出MaineCoon模型，包含自重采样、跨模态表示对齐、领域感知偏好优化、强化在线策略蒸馏（ROPD）等训练技术，以及首个支持千秒级生成的智能体流式推理框架（含缓存管理和提示规划）。
AI.result: 在单GPU上实现最高47.5 FPS的实时流式生成和亚秒级交互，建立了高质量、低延迟、长时段音视频自回归模型的新SOTA基准。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作不仅刷新了音视频自回归模型的性能基准，更指出了下一代AI原生社交平台所需的范式转变方向。

title: The Stanford EDGAR Filings Dataset: Reconstructing U.S. Corporate and Financial Disclosures into Layout-Faithful and Token-Efficient Pretraining Data
comment: Preprint. Includes appendix, tables, and figures
summary: As high-quality public web corpora become increasingly exhausted, clean long-context documents have become a scarce and expensive source of training data for large language models (LLMs). Existing long-context corpora are often proprietary and costly to acquire, synthetically generated, or concentrated in narrow domains such as programming. We introduce the Stanford EDGAR Filings Dataset (SEFD), an open reconstruction of SEC filings into layout-faithful MultiMarkdown for financial language modeling and evaluation. SEFD makes audited financial statements, risk disclosures, ownership reports, accounting notes, and market-moving event filings usable as long-context pretraining data and as a basis for financial reasoning, forecasting, compliance, and document understanding. The resulting corpus is token-efficient, model-ready, and has less than 0.1% overlap with Common Crawl-derived corpora. We release SEFD-v1, a 152B-token initial public snapshot, and provide corpus-level analyses of a larger 18.5M-filing archive estimated at 550B tokens. We further introduce two SEFD-derived benchmarks: EDGAR-Forecast, which evaluates filing-grounded numerical forecasting after model knowledge cutoffs, and EDGAR-OCR, which evaluates transcription of complex financial tables.

AI.tldr: SEFD是一个基于SEC文件重建的公开长上下文金融语料库，包含152B tokens的初始快照和两个金融评测基准，与Common Crawl重叠率低于0.1%。
AI.motivation: 高质量长上下文公开语料日益枯竭，现有金融语料多为专有、成本高昂、合成生成或局限于编程等窄领域，亟需开放、高质量的金融长上下文数据资源。
AI.method: 将SEC文件重建为布局保真的MultiMarkdown格式，构建了包含1850万份文件（约550B tokens）的档案库，并发布了152B tokens的初始快照SEFD-v1；同时设计了两个评测基准：EDGAR-Forecast（数值预测）和EDGAR-OCR（表格转录）。
AI.result: 发布SEFD-v1（152B tokens），与Common Crawl语料重叠率低于0.1%，并提供了两个金融领域评测基准。
AI.conclusion: SEFD为金融语言建模和评估提供了开放、高质量的长上下文预训练数据，可支持金融推理、预测、合规和文档理解等任务。

title: Million-scale multimodal pollen microscopy with expert-guided foundation models
comment: 31 pages, 5 main figures, supplementary information included. Submitted to Scientific Reports
summary: Automated pollen identification from microscopy remains a bottleneck in aerobiology, palaeoecology and biodiversity monitoring, because scalable systems must generalise across specimen preparation, scanner settings and geographic origins while retaining palynological interpretability. To address this gap, we present a million-scale multimodal pollen microscopy resource, Pollen AI Atlas, assembled from pure-species whole-slide bright-field images spanning four geographic origins, four scanner settings and 46 taxon labels across 31 botanical families. Seeded by one manually selected exemplar per source slide, token-level mining and filtering produced 1,511,390 released grain detections with 99.6\% proposal precision in expert-curated test regions. Each detection was paired with machine-generated grain-level morphological captions from five open-weight vision-language models, guided by expert-verified palynological anchors, yielding structured descriptions of aperture systems, wall ornamentation, shape and size. Among the evaluated models, Gemma4 provided the most controlled primary caption set, combining tight length control, no leakage and the strongest text-retrieval performance. Baseline benchmarks with frozen visual features reached 88.16\% top-1 accuracy, while cross-regional retrieval showed that caption-derived text embeddings remained robust when image similarity degraded (mAP@20 0.811 versus 0.262). Released data, annotations, captions, splits, code, and weights provide a benchmark for pollen recognition, cross-regional domain adaptation and domain-specific multimodal microscopy learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Pollen AI Atlas，一个百万级花粉显微图像多模态资源库，包含151万粒花粉检测结果及机器生成的结构化形态描述，为花粉自动识别和跨区域域适应提供了基准。
AI.motivation: 当前花粉自动识别系统在泛化性（样本制备、扫描设置、地理来源）和可解释性方面存在瓶颈，缺乏大规模、多模态的标注资源来支撑可扩展的识别方法。
AI.method: 从纯种全片亮场图像出发，通过token级挖掘和过滤获取151万粒花粉检测；利用五种开放权重视觉语言模型，在专家验证的花粉锚点指导下生成结构化形态描述（孔径系统、壁饰、形状、大小）。
AI.result: 检测提案精度达99.6%；冻结视觉特征基线top-1准确率88.16%；跨区域检索中文本嵌入mAP@20达0.811（图像相似度仅0.262）；Gemma4模型在文本生成控制与检索性能上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 该资源为花粉识别、跨区域域适应及领域专用多模态显微学习提供了完整基准，数据和代码已开放。

title: Fixed-Point Reasoners: Stable and Adaptive Deep Looped Transformers
summary: Looped architectures provide an inductive bias toward learning step-by-step procedures for tasks that require compositional reasoning. The number of effective layers reached by looping determines the quality of the solution these models find. Like deep architectures, looped architectures are prone to a signal propagation problem induced by depth as the halting decision is postponed. In this paper, we address this signal propagation issue using pre-norm layers and residual scaling. Building on these architectural modifications, we propose FPRM, a Transformer-based Fixed-Point Reasoning Model that uses fixed-point convergence as an end-to-end halting mechanism in a looped architecture. We show that fixed-point halting allows FPRM to adapt its compute to task difficulty. FPRM is effective on common reasoning benchmarks, namely Sudoku, Maze, state-tracking, and ARC-AGI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Transformer的固定点推理模型FPRM，通过循环架构和固定点收敛机制自适应调整计算量，有效解决深度循环架构中的信号传播问题，并在多个推理基准上验证效果。
AI.motivation: 循环架构因深度增加存在信号传播问题，且现有方法缺乏有效的端到端停止机制，导致计算资源无法根据任务难度自适应调整。
AI.method: 采用预层归一化和残差缩放解决信号传播问题，并基于固定点收敛作为循环架构的端到端停止机制，提出FPRM模型。
AI.result: 在Sudoku、Maze、状态追踪和ARC-AGI等多个推理基准上表现有效。
AI.conclusion: FPRM通过固定点停止机制实现了计算量随任务难度自适应调整，为循环架构的推理模型提供了有效解决方案。

title: Human-in-the-Loop Atlas-Based 3D Asset Segmentation for Interactive Content Workflows
summary: Segmenting 3D assets into meaningful regions remains challenging, especially when segmentation criteria are application-dependent and require user control. We present a human-in-the-loop pipeline for generating a segmented 2D parameterized atlas from a 3D model for interactive media, game, and XR content workflows. Our method first selects a compact set of rendered views using a greedy set cover strategy over sampled surface points, and then supports interactive segmentation of these views with SAM~2 and Label Studio. The resulting masks are back-projected onto the model's UV parameterization to produce a unified segmented atlas that supports downstream production tasks such as segment-wise material assignment, style transfer, and semantic labeling. We assess the pipeline through a demonstration-based technical evaluation on eight cultural heritage objects. The results show that the approach can generate usable segmented atlases across diverse geometries while revealing recurring sources of manual correction, particularly fine structures, cavities, and weak appearance boundaries.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种人机协同的3D模型分割流水线，通过主动选择视角、交互式分割（SAM2+Label Studio）和UV回投影，生成带标注的2D参数化图集，支持材质分配、风格迁移等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 3D资产分割标准依赖具体应用场景，现有方法缺乏用户控制能力，难以满足交互媒体、游戏和XR内容生产中对灵活分割的需求。
AI.method: 1) 用贪婪集覆盖策略从采样表面点中选择紧凑的渲染视图集；2) 结合SAM2和Label Studio对这些视图进行交互式分割；3) 将分割掩码反向投影到模型的UV参数化上，生成统一的分割图集。
AI.result: 在8个文化遗产物体上的演示性技术评估表明，该方法能够在多样几何体上生成可用的分割图集，同时揭示了需要人工修正的常见问题（精细结构、空腔、弱外观边界）。
AI.conclusion: 该人机协同流水线有效平衡了自动化效率与用户控制需求，为3D分割在数字内容创作中的应用提供了实用方案，但仍需进一步处理精细结构和弱边界等挑战。

title: EvolveNav: Proactive Preflection and Self-Evolving Memory for Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation
summary: Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation (ZS-OGN) requires embodied agents to explore and locate target objects without any prior training. To this end, recent methods leverage foundation models. But they typically rely on static priors and lack adaptation, which leads to repeated errors and costly trial and error. In this paper, we propose a self-evolving ZS-OGN framework that enables continuous test-time improvement. Specifically, we build an agentic rule memory by extracting actionable knowledge from past trajectories. Then, we propose a retrieval strategy based on upper confidence bound, selecting effective rules by balancing semantic relevance and historical success. In addition, we introduce a memory-guided preflection module that forecasts potential outcomes before action, reducing inefficient exploration. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing zero-shot baselines, achieving a 10.1\% improvement in success rate with fewer unnecessary steps.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种自我进化的零样本目标导航框架，通过构建智能规则记忆和基于置信上界的检索策略，实现测试时的持续改进，显著提升成功率的同時减少无效探索。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本目标导航方法依赖静态先验知识，缺乏自适应能力，导致重复错误和高代价的试错过程。
AI.method: 1) 从历史轨迹中提取可操作知识构建智能规则记忆；2) 基于上置信界(UCB)的检索策略，平衡语义相关性和历史成功率选择有效规则；3) 引入记忆引导的预反射模块，在行动前预测潜在结果以减少低效探索。
AI.result: 在多个基准上超越现有零样本方法，成功率提升10.1%，同时减少不必要的探索步骤。
AI.conclusion: 通过持续测试时自我进化，有效解决了静态先验导致的适应性问题，为零样本目标导航提供了更高效可靠的解决方案。

title: High-Fidelity 3D Geometric Reconstruction of Pelvic Organs from MRI: A Hybrid Deep Learning and Iterative Optimization Approach
summary: Patient-specific 3D reconstruction of pelvic organ geometry from MRI is important for pelvic floor modeling and downstream patient-specific analysis. However, while previous studies have focused primarily on either image segmentation or downstream use of 3D models, the reconstruction of high-fidelity, high-quality geometries remains labor-intensive and poorly standardized. The study introduced a hybrid deformable shape modeling framework that integrates deep learning prediction with iterative optimization for the reconstruction of the bladder, uterus, and rectum. The framework consists of three core components: a geometry-aware multi-level deep learning architecture that preserves topological consistency of pelvic organs; a two-stage amortized optimization training strategy that balances global shape capture and local surface refinement; and a holistic synergy mechanism--where iterative optimization provides supervision for deep learning during the training phase, and during inference, deep learning rapidly predicts the global organ morphology, followed by iterative optimization to refine local surfaces and mesh quality. This framework demonstrated marked superiority in geometric fidelity than current mainstream deep learning-based organ reconstruction models. For individual anatomical structures, the reconstructed 3D geometries for the bladder, rectum, and uterus achieved significantly lower Chamfer Distance values and higher Dice Similarity Coefficient scores. In addition, while maintaining high computational efficiency, the proposed architecture yielded superior overall volumetric mesh quality. At the patient level, the framework achieved higher mean values for the 10 worst elements for both minSICN and minSIGE compared to traditional geometric post-processing algorithms.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种混合可变形形状建模框架，结合深度学习预测与迭代优化，用于从MRI重建高保真、高质量的盆腔器官（膀胱、子宫、直肠）三维几何结构，在几何 fidelity、网格质量等方面显著优于现有主流方法。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注图像分割或三维模型的下游使用，但高保真、高质量的盆腔器官几何重建仍依赖大量人工、缺乏标准化流程。
AI.method: 构建了混合可变形形状建模框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 几何感知的多级深度学习架构，保持器官拓扑一致性；2) 两阶段摊销优化训练策略，平衡全局形状捕获与局部表面细化；3) 整体协同机制——训练时迭代优化为深度学习提供监督，推理时深度学习快速预测全局形态后再通过迭代优化细化局部表面和网格质量。
AI.result: 在几何 fidelity 上显著优于主流深度学习重建模型；膀胱、直肠、子宫的 Chamfer Distance 更低、Dice 系数更高；计算效率高的同时获得了更优的体网格质量；在患者层面，最差10个元素的 minSICN 和 minSIGE 均值优于传统几何后处理算法。
AI.conclusion: 该混合框架有效解决了盆腔器官三维重建中质量与标准化不足的问题，为患者特异性盆底建模和分析提供了更可靠的技术方案。

title: Revisiting Structural Dependency in Autoregressive Multi-Task Table Recognition via Order-Independent Cell-Level Representations
summary: Multi-task table recognition jointly addresses table structure prediction, cell localization, and cell content recognition within a unified framework. Existing approaches often rely on autoregressive decoders to generate table structures and reuse their hidden states for cell localization and content recognition. This autoregressive generation process can make cell representations order-dependent, degrading global consistency across cells. This paper proposes a structural refinement module that produces order-independent cell features through non-causal attention. This design enables parallel inference of cell contents while conditioning each cell on global context encoded in the refined features. Experiments on two large datasets demonstrate consistent gains in cell localization and end-to-end recognition, while reducing overall inference time by around threefold.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结构精炼模块，通过非因果注意力生成与顺序无关的单元格特征，实现并行推理，在表格识别任务中提升定位和识别效果，并减少约三倍推理时间。
AI.motivation: 现有基于自回归解码器的多任务表格识别方法使单元格表示依赖于生成顺序，导致全局一致性下降。
AI.method: 提出结构精炼模块，采用非因果注意力生成与顺序无关的单元格特征，支持并行推理单元格内容，并利用全局上下文进行条件化。
AI.result: 在两个大型数据集上，单元格定位和端到端识别性能一致提升，推理时间减少约三倍。
AI.conclusion: 非因果注意力机制能有效解决自回归带来的顺序依赖问题，在提升表格识别性能的同时显著加速推理。

title: Plug-and-Adapt: Multimodal Coreference Resolution at First Sight with a Pretrained Alignment Model
summary: Visual information helps resolve ambiguity in coreference resolution, leading to notable performance gains. However, existing Multi-modal Coreference Resolution (MCR) methods require training with (partially) annotated data from the target dataset before they can be applied, preventing their direct usability and raising concerns about generalization. While Vision-Language Large Models (VLLMs) with billions of parameters offer promising zero-shot capabilities, they remain largely inaccessible. Their massive size limits deployability, and many are only accessible through paid APIs. In this paper, we propose a plug-and-adapt method that strategically adapts a carefully pre-trained \emph{alignment model} for immediate use in MCR tasks, designed to eliminate the need for training on scarce benchmark datasets or relying on resource-intensive VLLMs. Specifically, we first pre-train a fine-grained alignment model between textual and visual contextual information using vision-language alignment datasets. We then repurpose the alignment model to MCR through similarity aggregation by fusing visual and categorical cues with evidence theory, thereby enhancing effectiveness. Experiments on the Coreference Image Narratives (CIN) benchmark dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, achieving a 5.31\% and 2.12\% improvement in CoNLL F1 over SOTA dedicated methods and popular VLLMs, respectively. We further evaluate our method on a masked CIN dataset for robustness testing and on a specially constructed VCR-MCR dataset for generalization assessment, with results confirming both capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种即插即用的多模态指代消解方法，通过预训练的细粒度对齐模型结合证据理论融合视觉与类别线索，无需目标数据集训练或依赖大型视觉语言模型，在CIN基准上超越现有方法，CoNLL F1提升5.31%，并展现出良好的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MCR方法需要目标数据集标注训练，泛化性差；大型VLLM参数量大、部署难且需付费API，实际可用性低。本文旨在设计一种无需训练或依赖大型模型的即插即用MCR方法。
AI.method: 1) 利用视觉-语言对齐数据集预训练细粒度的文本-视觉上下文对齐模型；2) 通过对齐模型进行相似度聚合，结合证据理论融合视觉线索与类别线索，实现MCR的零样本适配。
AI.result: 在CIN数据集上，CoNLL F1比SOTA专用方法提升5.31%，比流行VLLMs提升2.12%；在掩码CIN和VCR-MCR数据集上验证了鲁棒性和泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效避免了训练依赖和大型模型限制，为多模态指代消解提供了一种轻量、即用且性能优异的零样本方案。

title: MLLMs Get It Right, Then Get It Wrong: Tracing and Correcting Late-Layer Textual Bias
summary: When vision contradicts text, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) consistently favor text, even when images provide clear evidence otherwise. This bias poses risks for applications requiring visual grounding, yet its cause remains unclear. In this paper, we uncover a surprising finding: models often get it right initially, forming correct vision-based predictions in their intermediate layers, before changing their minds and favoring text in the final output. We call this "late-layer textual override". The visual information is encoded, it simply does not survive to the output. More intriguingly, we find that how predictions change reveals whether they're correct: 85% of failures shift toward text, while 89% of successes shift toward vision. This directional signature enables a simple but powerful intervention: when we detect a confident visual prediction being suppressed, we restore it. We propose CALRD (Conflict-Aware Layer Reference Decoding), a training-free method that recovers overridden predictions at inference time. Experiments across five MLLMs of varying architectures demonstrate up to 9.4% absolute improvements on conflict benchmarks while largely preserving standard performance, without training or external knowledge. It recovers what the model already knew but failed to preserve.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多模态大模型在图像与文本冲突时，中间层其实已经正确理解了图像信息，但在最终输出层被文本信息覆盖。作者提出了一种无需训练的解码方法CALRD，通过在推理时恢复被抑制的正确视觉预测，在冲突基准上最高提升9.4%的绝对性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在面对视觉与文本冲突时倾向于相信文本而非图像，这种偏见会损害需要视觉理解的应用，但根本原因尚不清楚。
AI.method: 通过分析模型中间层，发现模型在早期层能正确基于视觉做出预测，但在后期层被文本信息覆盖（称为"晚层文本覆盖"）。基于此，提出CALRD（冲突感知层参考解码），一种无需训练、在推理时检测并恢复被抑制的正确视觉预测的方法。
AI.result: 在五种不同架构的多模态大模型上，冲突基准测试中最高获得9.4%的绝对性能提升，同时基本保持标准性能不变。
AI.conclusion: 模型已经知道正确答案，只是没有保留到输出。通过恢复被覆盖的视觉预测，可以有效缓解多模态大模型的文本偏见问题。

title: SegDINO: Introducing Multi-Scale Structure into DINO for Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Self-supervised DINO models provide strong transferable visual representations, yet applying them directly to image segmentation remains challenging. Existing approaches commonly rely on heavy decoders with complex upsampling, introducing substantial parameter and computational overhead. We observe that introducing scale into DINO features is far more critical than increasing decoder capacity. In this work, we present SegDINO, an efficient segmentation framework that integrates a DINOv3 backbone with lightweight scale modeling. SegDINO introduces Token Pyramid Adaptation (TPA) to reorganize intermediate DINO features into a pseudo multi-scale hierarchy, and Scale-Aware Decoding (SAD) for efficient intra-scale refinement and top-down multi-scale propagation. We further curate PanCT, a new CT dataset containing 284 patients with expert-annotated pancreatic tumors, to assess SegDINO's ability to handle difficult small-lesion cases. Extensive experiments on PanCT and three public benchmarks demonstrate that SegDINO achieves state-of-the-art results with high efficiency. The code is available at https://github.com/script-Yang/segdino_v2.

AI.tldr: SegDINO是一个高效分割框架，通过在DINOv3骨干中引入轻量级尺度建模（Token Pyramid Adaptation和Scale-Aware Decoding），实现了SOTA分割性能，并发布了新的胰腺CT数据集PanCT。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖重型解码器和复杂上采样，引入大量参数和计算开销。作者观察到在DINO特征中引入尺度比增加解码器容量更关键，因此希望用轻量级尺度建模实现高效分割。
AI.method: 提出SegDINO框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) Token Pyramid Adaptation (TPA) - 将DINO中间特征重组为伪多尺度层级；(2) Scale-Aware Decoding (SAD) - 实现高效的尺度内细化和自上而下的多尺度传播。
AI.result: 在PanCT（284例胰腺肿瘤新数据集）和三个公开基准上，SegDINO达到SOTA结果且效率高。
AI.conclusion: 尺度建模比增加解码器容量更关键；SegDINO以轻量级设计实现了高效且准确的分割，适用于小病灶等困难场景。

title: Gaussian Light Field Splatting: A Physical Prior-Driven Vision Transformer for Unsupervised Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Existing unsupervised low-light image enhancement methods often encounter local exposure imbalance and color distortion under complex non-uniform illumination. In addition, most Vision Transformers lack an explicit mechanism for modeling the physical priors of illumination degradation. To address these limitations, we propose GLFS, a Gaussian light field splatting-based Vision Transformer that integrates continuous physical illumination modeling from Gaussian splatting into the Transformer architecture. In GLFS, scene illumination is represented by a superposition of anisotropic Gaussian basis functions. Physics-guided biases are introduced into self-attention to adaptively infer a spatial gain field, enabling accurate and uniform restoration under complex illumination. To reduce color bias and structural degradation during enhancement, a color-vector angular loss and a luminance-edge loss are further developed. These losses enforce hue consistency and improve the structural fidelity of local details. Extensive ablation studies and quantitative evaluations show that GLFS provides clear advantages in illumination correction and detail preservation. It achieves state-of-the-art performance and offers a new representation paradigm for low-light image enhancement.

AI.tldr: 提出GLFS，一种基于高斯光场溅射的Vision Transformer方法，通过引入连续物理照明建模和物理引导的自注意力机制，解决非均匀光照下的局部曝光失衡和颜色失真问题，在低光图像增强任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督低光图像增强方法在复杂非均匀光照下存在局部曝光失衡和颜色失真，且多数Vision Transformer缺乏显式的光照退化物理先验建模机制。
AI.method: GLFS将高斯溅射的连续物理光照建模引入Transformer架构：用各向异性高斯基函数叠加表示场景光照，在自注意力中引入物理引导偏置自适应推断空间增益场，并提出颜色矢量角度损失和亮度边缘损失来减少色偏和保持结构 fidelity。
AI.result: 大量消融实验和定量评估表明，GLFS在光照校正和细节保持方面具有明显优势，实现了SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: GLFS为低光图像增强提供了一种新的表示范式，有效结合了连续物理光照建模与Transformer架构。

title: AIGS-Net: Compact Illumination Field Modeling via 2D Gaussian Splatting for Fast Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Existing low-light image enhancement methods often face a bottleneck between the representation capacity of illumination-field modeling and computational complexity. To address this issue, this paper proposes an Adaptive Illumination Gaussian Splatting Network (AIGS-Net), an ultra-lightweight architecture for fast low-light enhancement. Unlike conventional static priors, AIGS-Net constructs an input-adaptive 2D Gaussian Splatting illumination field. The opacity of Gaussian basis functions is dynamically modulated by relative luminance statistics of the input image, and spatially varying illumination compensation is rendered through ordered alpha compositing. To guide adaptive illumination compensation efficiently, a zero-parameter nonlinear multiscale contextual encoding module is introduced to extract low-frequency structures and local contrast cues without additional convolutional weights. To suppress noise amplification and sensor-induced color bias, AIGS-Net integrates noise-mask estimation, locked single-channel Gamma mapping, cross-channel consistency regularization, and target color-alignment constraints. Experiments on LOL and LSRW benchmarks show that AIGS-Net improves detail recovery and color fidelity while requiring only approximately 40 learnable parameters, achieving an effective trade-off between enhancement quality and extreme inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出AIGS-Net，一种仅约40个可学习参数的超轻量级低光照图像增强网络，通过自适应2D高斯泼溅光照场实现高效增强。
AI.motivation: 现有低光照增强方法在光照场建模的表达能力与计算复杂度之间存在瓶颈，亟需一种既轻量又有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 构建输入自适应的2D高斯泼溅光照场，通过相对亮度统计动态调制高斯基函数不透明度，并采用有序Alpha合成渲染光照补偿；引入零参数非线性多尺度上下文编码模块提取低频结构与局部对比度线索；集成噪声掩码估计、单通道Gamma映射、跨通道一致性正则化及目标颜色对齐约束。
AI.result: 在LOL和LSRW基准上，仅约40个可学习参数即可提升细节恢复和色彩保真度，实现增强质量与推理效率的优异平衡。
AI.conclusion: AIGS-Net通过极轻量架构有效解决了低光照增强中的表达-复杂度矛盾，展示了参数效率与性能兼顾的可行性。

title: HLS-GPT: A Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT) for Continental-Scale NASA Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 (HLS) Reflectance Reconstruction Across All Bands on Arbitrary Dates
summary: Recent deep learning methods for Landsat and Sentinel-2 reflectance time series reconstruction remain limited by restricted spectral coverage, limited geographic scalability, or patch-based designs with short temporal contexts. We present HLS-GPT, a large-scale generative pretrained Transformer model for reconstructing NASA Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 30 m surface reflectance for all bands, any date, and any pixel location. HLS-GPT uses a hierarchical Transformer architecture to handle the different spectral band configurations of Landsat and Sentinel-2 and operates on single-pixel 12-month time series. To capture geographic and seasonal variability, the model was trained with nine years of HLS time series from more than 0.25 million training pixels across the conterminous United States. A random cropping and masking strategy extracts 12-month periods with varying start dates across epochs, masks 50% of valid observations, and trains the model to reconstruct the masked reflectance values from the remaining observations. Evaluation using more than 62,000 independent test pixels shows robust reconstruction under diverse land surface conditions, including complex crop phenology and sparse, irregular observations. Leave-one-observation-out evaluation achieved reconstruction RMSE below 0.026 for all HLS spectral bands, with relative RMSE below 35% for visible bands and below 13% for other bands. Red-edge band errors were comparable to red and near-infrared errors despite the absence of red-edge bands on Landsat. Sensitivity analyses that randomly masked 10% to 90% of test observations showed only modest degradation when 10% to 50% of observations were masked, with all-band RMSE below 0.028. Image reconstruction over nine independent 109 by 109 km CONUS HLS tiles further demonstrates that HLS-GPT outperforms two conventional methods and the NASA-IBM Prithvi model.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为HLS-GPT的大尺度生成式预训练Transformer模型，用于重建NASA Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 30米地表反射率的所有波段、任意日期和任意像素位置。该模型使用分层Transformer架构处理不同的光谱波段配置，基于单像素12个月时间序列，在美国本土超过25万像素的九年HLS时间序列上训练，在独立测试中表现出鲁棒的重建能力，RMSE低于0.026。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于深度学习的Landsat和Sentinel-2反射率时间序列重建方法存在光谱覆盖受限、地理可扩展性有限、或采用短时间上下文的基于块的设计等问题，亟需一种能覆盖所有波段、任意日期和任意位置的大尺度重建方法。
AI.method: 采用分层Transformer架构处理Landsat和Sentinel-2的不同光谱波段配置；基于单像素12个月时间序列；使用美国本土九年HLS时间序列，超过25万像素进行训练；采用随机裁剪和掩码策略，提取不同起始日期的12个月周期，掩码50%的有效观测，训练模型重建被掩码的反射率值。
AI.result: 在超过62,000个独立测试像素上实现鲁棒重建；留一观测评估中所有HLS光谱波段重建RMSE低于0.026，可见波段相对RMSE低于35%，其他波段低于13%；红边波段误差与红波段和近红外误差相当；10%-50%观测被掩码时仅出现轻微退化，全波段RMSE低于0.028；在九个独立CONUS HLS图块上优于两种传统方法和NASA-IBM Prithvi模型。
AI.conclusion: HLS-GPT能够在大尺度上实现高精度的HLS地表反射率重建，适用于多样化的地表条件和稀疏不规则观测，具有良好的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: Neural Tree Reconstruction for the Open Forest Observatory
comment: Published as a workshop paper at "Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning", ICLR 2024
summary: The Open Forest Observatory (OFO) is a collaboration across universities and other partners to make low-cost forest mapping accessible to ecologists, land managers, and the general public. The OFO is building both a database of geospatial forest data as well as open-source methods and tools for forest mapping by uncrewed aerial vehicle. Such data are useful for a variety of climate applications including prioritizing reforestation efforts, informing wildfire hazard reduction, and monitoring carbon sequestration. In the current iteration of the OFO's forest map database, 3D tree maps are created using classical structure-from-motion techniques. This approach is prone to artifacts, lacks detail, and has particular difficulty on the forest floor where the input data (overhead imagery) has limited visibility. These reconstruction errors can potentially propagate to the downstream scientific tasks (e.g. a wildfire simulation.) Advances in 3D reconstruction, including methods like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), produce higher quality results that are more robust to sparse views and support data-driven priors. We explore ways to incorporate NeRFs into the OFO dataset, outline future work to support even more state-of-the-art 3D vision models, and describe the importance of high-quality 3D reconstructions for forestry applications.

AI.tldr: Open Forest Observatory (OFO)是一个跨大学合作项目，旨在通过低成本无人机航拍和开源工具构建森林地理空间数据库。当前使用经典运动恢复结构方法生成3D树图，但存在伪影和细节缺失问题，尤其在地面区域。文章探索引入NeRF等先进3D重建技术以提升质量，并讨论了高质量重建在森林应用中的重要性。
AI.motivation: 传统结构运动(SfM)方法在森林3D重建中存在伪影多、细节差、地面可见性有限等问题，这些误差会传播到下游科学任务（如野火模拟、碳汇监测），因此需要更高质量的3D重建方法。
AI.method: OFO平台结合无人机航拍与经典SfM技术构建3D树图数据库，并探索引入Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)等先进3D重建方法，以提升对稀疏视图的鲁棒性和重建质量。
AI.result: NeRF方法相比经典SfM能产生更高质量的3D重建结果，对稀疏视图更鲁棒，且支持数据驱动先验，可有效减少伪影并提升细节表现。
AI.conclusion: 将NeRF等先进3D视觉模型集成到OFO数据库中有望显著提升森林3D重建质量，从而更好地支持造林规划、 wildfire风险降低和碳汇监测等气候应用。

title: ReAge3D: Re-Aging 3D Faces with View Consistency
summary: We present a novel framework for realistic and controllable 3D face re-aging which produces highly detailed, identity-preserving results. Existing 3D editing methods, while effective for coarse semantic changes, are not well suited for re-aging, as even small inconsistencies across re-aged 2D views can lead to over-smoothing of subtle but perceptually important age-related details. To address this challenge, we first introduce a 2D diffusion-based re-aging model, DiffReaging, trained on synthetically generated image pairs. We further propose a center-out editing propagation strategy that leverages this re-aging model to reconstruct multi-view-consistent re-aged images. Specifically, starting from a re-aged frontal pivot view, we reconstruct the remaining views through warping and our proposed Masked-DiffReaging process. By injecting existing content at every step of the diffusion process, Masked-DiffReaging ensures that the reconstructed regions remain coherent with existing pixels. The resulting consistent set of re-aged views supervises the optimization of the re-aged 3D representation. Our method outperforms existing 3D editing techniques both visually and quantitatively, enabling smooth, fine-grained control over age transformations in 3D face models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于扩散模型的3D人脸年龄编辑框架，通过中心向外传播策略和多视图一致性重建，实现精细、可控的面部老化/年轻化效果。
AI.motivation: 现有3D编辑方法在年龄编辑上效果不佳，因为跨视角的微小不一致会导致重要的年龄细节被过度平滑。需要一种能保持多视图一致性的精细年龄编辑方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出DiffReaging，一个基于合成图像对训练的2D扩散年龄编辑模型；2) 提出中心向外编辑传播策略，从正面视角开始，通过扭曲和Masked-DiffReaging过程重建其他视角；3) Masked-DiffReaging在扩散每一步注入已有内容，确保重建区域与现有像素一致；4) 用一致的多视角年龄编辑图像优化3D表示。
AI.result: 在视觉质量和量化指标上均优于现有3D编辑技术，实现了平滑、细粒度的年龄变换控制。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了3D人脸年龄编辑中多视角一致性和细节保留的挑战，为可控3D人脸老化提供了新思路。

title: EgoCS-400K: An Egocentric Gameplay Dataset for World Models
summary: The shift from video generation to interactive world modeling places new demands on data: beyond captioned videos, world models require temporally aligned video-action-language trajectories grounded in the actions, camera motion, states, and events that drive future scene changes. However, such data is difficult to obtain at scale. Web video datasets offer broad visual coverage but lack executable actions and reliable states; robotic datasets provide action and state supervision but are costly and limited in scene diversity; and existing simulators often lack large-scale human-driven interaction trajectories. In this paper, we introduce EgoCS-400K, a large-scale replay-grounded egocentric Counter-Strike dataset for world models, built from public professional CS and CS2 match demos that preserve human gameplay trajectories and enable parsing, replaying, rendering, and temporal alignment. We extract player states, view directions, movements, keyboard/button inputs, view-angle changes, weapon usage, game events, and round-level context, and render clean first-person videos from the same trajectories. EgoCS-400K contains over 400,000 first-person videos and 10,000 hours of gameplay from more than 1,000 matches and 40,000 rounds, covering 13 maps and 10 player viewpoints per round. It supports a range of interactive visual modeling tasks, including action-conditioned future prediction, state- and event-aware scene rollout, replay-grounded captioning, and agent egocentric action understanding. By connecting visual observations with human actions, camera motion, game states, and events at scale, EgoCS-400K serves as a practical bridge between passive web videos, controllable game simulation, and costly real-world embodied data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EgoCS-400K，一个基于反恐精英游戏回放的大规模、可重放的第一人称数据集，包含超过40万段视频、1万小时游戏时长，支持动作条件未来预测、状态事件感知场景展开等世界模型任务，弥补了被动网络视频与真实具身数据之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型所需的数据（视频-动作-语言轨迹）难以大规模获取：网络视频缺乏可执行动作和可靠状态，机器人数据成本高且场景多样性有限，模拟器缺乏大规模人类交互轨迹。
AI.method: 从公开的CS/CS2职业比赛回放中解析玩家状态、视角、键盘输入、武器使用、游戏事件等信号，并渲染干净的第一人称视频，构建了40万+视频、1万+小时、涵盖13张地图和40,000回合的数据集。
AI.result: EgoCS-400K包含超过400,000个第一人称视频、10,000小时游戏时长、1,000+场比赛、40,000+回合、13张地图，每回合提供10个玩家视角。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为连接被动网络视频、可控游戏模拟与昂贵真实世界数据提供了实用桥梁，支持多种交互式视觉建模任务。

title: Adaptive Volumetric Mechanical Property Fields Invariant to Resolution
comment: Project Page and hi-res paper: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/adavomp/. ICML 2026
summary: Accurate mechanical properties (or materials) Young's modulus ($E$), Poisson's ratio ($ν$) and density ($ρ$) are essential for reliable physics simulation of digital worlds, but most 3D assets lack this information. We propose AdaVoMP, a method for predicting accurate dense spatially-varying ($E$, $ν$, $ρ$) for input 3D objects across representations, improving the resolution, accuracy, and memory efficiency over the state-of-the-art. The foundation of our technique is a sparse and adaptive voxel structure SAV that efficiently represents both the input 3D shape and the material field output. We replace the fixed-voxel model of the most accurate prior method, VoMP, with a novel sparse transformer encoder-decoder model that learns to generate a unique SAV autoregressively for every input shape to represent its materials, achieving a resolution $16^3\times$ higher than prior art. Experiments show that AdaVoMP estimates more accurate volumetric properties, even with lesser test-time compute than all prior art. This allows us to convert high-resolution complex 3D objects into simulation-ready assets, resulting in realistic deformable simulations.

AI.tldr: AdaVoMP提出了一种基于稀疏自适应体素结构(SAV)的预测方法，能够为任意3D物体预测高分辨率、空间变化的材料属性（杨氏模量、泊松比、密度），分辨率比现有技术高16³倍，且计算效率更高。
AI.motivation: 数字世界中的物理仿真需要准确的力学属性（杨氏模量、泊松比、密度），但大多数3D资产缺乏这些信息，现有方法在分辨率、精度和内存效率上存在不足。
AI.method: 提出稀疏自适应体素结构(SAV)高效表示输入形状和材料场；将VoMP的固定体素模型替换为稀疏Transformer编码器-解码器模型，通过自回归方式为每个输入形状生成唯一的SAV来预测材料属性。
AI.result: 分辨率比先前最优方法高16³倍；即使测试时计算量更少，也能估计更准确的体积属性；能将高分辨率复杂3D物体转换为可直接仿真的资产，实现逼真的可变形仿真。
AI.conclusion: AdaVoMP在分辨率、精度和内存效率上均超越现有方法，为数字世界的物理仿真提供了更高效、更准确的材料属性预测方案。

title: MOCHI: Motion Enhancement of Collaborative Human-object Interactions
summary: Collaborative human-object interaction shows dynamic and complex movements that require mutual anticipation and continuous adjustment between participants and the shared object. Modeling such collaborative multi-human object interaction (MHOI) scenarios requires high-quality data acquisition as a foundational step; however, this is challenging due to the inherent complexity of MHOI where human-human and human-object interactions occur simultaneously. Such complexity leads to noisy MHOI captures characterized by several artifacts: contact misalignment between hands and objects, motion jitter and temporal inconsistencies in the captured sequences, and missing or incomplete finger-level articulation details. To address these challenges, we present MOCHI (MOtion Enhancement of Collaborative Human-object Interactions), a two-stage framework for enhancing noisy MHOI data. Our approach first generates physically plausible hand grasps through optimization from noisy body input, producing grasps that are both physically plausible and semantically consistent with the body pose, where these optimized grasps are extended into complete hand-object interaction sequences. Consequently, the full-body motion for all participants are refined through a diffusion-based noise optimization framework that uses single-person motion priors. During the optimization process, we introduce optimization objectives to encode human-object and human-human interaction information within these single-person priors. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our pipeline across diverse MHOI data, either acquired by existing capture methods or synthesized by generative models. We further show robustness of our system across varying numbers of participants and types of interactions, and demonstrate various applications including keyframe-based MHOI creation and data augmentation through varying object geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出MOCHI框架，通过两阶段优化（物理合理的抓取生成+扩散噪声优化）来增强协作式多人-物体交互数据，解决数据捕获中的接触错位、运动抖动和手指细节缺失问题。
AI.motivation: 协作式多人-物体交互(MHOI)数据采集因同时存在人-人和人-物交互而复杂度高，导致捕获数据存在接触错位、运动抖动、手指细节缺失等噪声问题，亟需有效的数据增强方法。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1) 从含噪声的身体输入通过优化生成物理合理且语义一致的抓取姿态，并扩展为完整手-物交互序列；2) 利用基于扩散的噪声优化框架，结合单人体运动先验，在优化过程中引入人-物和人-人交互约束来精修全身运动。
AI.result: 在多种MHOI数据上验证有效性（包括现有捕获方法和生成模型合成数据），展示了在不同参与者数量和交互类型下的鲁棒性，并演示了关键帧MHOI创建和变几何数据增强等应用。
AI.conclusion: MOCHI能有效增强含噪声的多人-物体交互数据，为高质量MHOI数据获取提供了可行的解决方案，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: Unified Multimodal Autoregressive Modeling with Shared Context-Visual Tokenizer is Key to Unification
comment: Accepted by ICML2026. Project page https://sharelab-sii.github.io/uniar-web
summary: Unified Multimodal Modeling aims to integrate visual understanding and generation within a single system. However, existing approaches typically rely on two disparate visual tokenizers, which splits the representation space and hinders truly unified modeling. We propose UniAR, a unified autoregressive framework where a single discrete visual tokenizer serves as the key bridge between understanding and generation, enabling a shared context in which the model can directly interpret its own generated visual tokens without additional re-encoding. UniAR adapts a pretrained vision encoder with multi-level feature fusion and a lookup-free bitwise quantization scheme, preserving both high-level semantics and low-level details while scaling the effective visual vocabulary at minimal cost. Building on this, the unified autoregressive model adopts parallel-bitwise-prediction to jointly predict spatially grouped, multi-level visual codes, substantially reducing visual sequence length and accelerating generation. Finally, a diffusion-based visual decoder operates on discrete visual tokens to decode high-fidelity images. Through large-scale pre-training, followed by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, UniAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on image generation and image editing while remaining competitive on multimodal understanding benchmarks. The project page is available at https://sharelab-sii.github.io/uniar-web.

AI.tldr: UniAR提出统一自回归框架，使用单一离散视觉分词器桥接视觉理解与生成，通过多级特征融合、无查找比特量化、并行比特预测和扩散解码器，在图像生成和编辑任务上达到SOTA，同时保持多模态理解竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态建模方法依赖两个不同的视觉分词器，导致表示空间分裂，阻碍了真正的统一建模。
AI.method: 1) 单一离散视觉分词器作为理解与生成的桥梁；2) 多级特征融合的预训练视觉编码器；3) 无查找比特量化方案扩增有效视觉词汇量；4) 并行比特预测联合预测空间分组的多级视觉编码，缩短序列长度加速生成；5) 基于扩散的视觉解码器从离散视觉标记解码图像；6) 大规模预训练+监督微调+强化学习。
AI.result: 在图像生成和图像编辑任务上达到SOTA性能，在多模态理解基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 单一视觉分词器+统一自回归框架+并行比特预测+扩散解码的有效组合，能够实现真正的视觉理解与生成统一，且性能优异。
